content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Minneapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential requires either a bachelor's degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional years of hands-on experience. Review PMI's specific education and experience thresholds, then gather your project records—employers across Minneapolis's healthcare, finance, technology, and manufacturing sectors recognize this credential's value.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® prep course. Attend sessions on your own schedule from anywhere, with active certified practitioners leading real-world case studies and exam-focused instruction. This formal education satisfies PMI's contact-hour requirement and builds the knowledge base you'll need to pass.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and submit your formal PMP® application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's portal. Granite PM Academy's support team can guide you through each submission step.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner. On exam day, you'll answer scenario-based questions that test your ability to lead projects in real workplace conditions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. During this cycle, earn and submit professional development units (PDUs) through approved continuing education, volunteer work, or publications. Plan your PDU activities early so renewal remains straightforward when your certification anniversary approaches.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
